```yaml
name: Stale Issues and PRs

on:
  schedule:
    # Run once a day at midnight UTC
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Mark stale issues and PRs
        uses: actions/stale@v9
        with:
          # Mark as stale after 30 days of inactivity
          days-before-stale: 30
          # Close after 7 days of being stale
          days-before-close: 7
          # Labels to add when stale
          stale-issue-label: 'stale'
          stale-pr-label: 'stale'
          # Labels to add when closed
          close-issue-label: 'closed'
          close-pr-label: 'closed'
          # Messages to post when marking stale
          stale-issue-message: |
            This issue has been marked stale because it has not had recent activity.
            If you still need help, please comment or add a new issue.
          stale-pr-message: |
            This pull request has been marked stale because it has not had recent activity.
            If you still need help, please comment or add a new issue.
          # Messages to post when closing
          close-issue-message: |
            Closing this issue because it has been stale for too long.
          close-pr-message: |
            Closing this pull request because it has been stale for too long.
          # Exempt labels (issues or PRs with these labels will not be marked stale)
          exempt-issue-labels: 'pinned,help wanted'
          exempt-pr-labels: 'pinned,help wanted'
          # Exempt assignees (issues or PRs assigned to these users will not be marked stale)
          exempt-issue-assignees: 'maintainer,repo-owner'
          exempt-pr-assignees: 'maintainer,repo-owner'
          # Exempt milestones (issues or PRs in these milestones will not be marked stale)
          exempt-issue-milestones: 'v1.0,Upcoming'
          exempt-pr-milestones: 'v1.0,Upcoming'
          # Do not close issues or PRs that have comments from the bot
          exempt-issue-commenters: 'github-actions[bot]'
          exempt-pr-commenters: 'github-actions[bot]'
          # Do not close issues or PRs that have a comment from the bot
          exempt-issue-issue: 'github-actions[bot]'
          exempt-pr-issue: 'github-actions[bot]'
```
